paper.title: High-accuracy variational Monte Carlo for frustrated magnets with deep neural networks
paper.authors: Christopher Roth, Attila Szabó, Allan MacDonald

results.system_description: 10x10 square lattice, periodic; J1 = 1, J2 = 0.5; S = sigma/2; total Sz = 0
results.source_location: Table I, p. 4 (row J2/J1 = 0.5, 10 × 10, column 'Our work')
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the GCNN; the Ref. [7] column (RBM+PP) is a quoted comparison and excluded.
results.notes: Also tabulated in arXiv:2310.05715v2 Table 1 with 67548 parameters. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.

results.system_description: 6x6 triangular lattice, periodic along both primitive vectors; J = 1; S = sigma/2; total Sz = 0
results.source_location: Table III, p. 7 (row J2/J1 = 0, N = 36, column GCNN)
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the GCNN on the 36-site periodic triangular cluster; exact value -0.5603734 given alongside.
results.notes: varbench triangular_36_P lists the exact diagonalization value -80.6937689612426 in the Pauli convention, i.e. -0.5603734 per site in the spin convention. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.

results.system_description: J₁–J₂ Heisenberg, 10 × 10 · J₂/J₁ = 0.55 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J1 sum_<ij> S_i · S_j + J2 sum_<<ij>> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S = sigma/2; J1 = 1; J2 = 0.55; no constant shift
results.source_location: Table I (tab: square GS), row J2/J1 = 0.55, 10 × 10, column "Our work"
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the GCNN; the Nomura et al. column and the exact/interpolated and other benchmark columns are quoted comparisons and excluded.
results.notes: Spin-1/2 J1-J2 model, periodic clusters. The square-lattice GCNNs have L layers of six feature maps (Sec. Ground-state energies).
